summary: GridAI Technologies Corp. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) to report regaining Nasdaq compliance after filing its delinquent Form 10-K for FY 2025. On May 4, 2026, Nasdaq notified the company that it had cured the Rule 5250(c)(1) deficiency. No transaction, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special-situation event occurred; this is a routine compliance update.
